reviews.text: Excellent professional! Very attentive, patient, and caring with Zeus. You can see the care and dedication in every lesson. We are very satisfied with the work and recommend him.
Excellent professional, very patient and dedicated. Zeus improved a lot with the training and was always treated with great care. I recommend his work!

I only have praise for Gabriel's work! He has always shown great patience, care, and affection for Zeus, in addition to explaining everything clearly so that we can continue the training in our daily lives.

It's wonderful to see that the work isn't just about teaching commands, but understanding the dog's behavior and respecting its pace. You can see Gabriel's professionalism and dedication in every lesson.

Zeus and I are very grateful for all the care. I definitely recommend him! 🐶💙
Thank you so much for your trust, Guilherme! I'm very happy with your feedback and I hope to continue helping families have an even better relationship with their pets. Big hug!
Breno, thank you so much for trusting in my work! It's wonderful to be able to contribute to a more peaceful and healthy relationship between pet owners and their animals. Count on me!
Luiz, thank you so much for your feedback and trust! I'm happy to have the opportunity to help pet owners better understand their animals and build an even better relationship. Best regards!
Gabriel helped me a lot; his approach to dog training is modern, humane, and efficient!

Excellent service! Very informative and personalized, I thought I was going to receive a ready-made PDF, but I was very surprised by the professional's quality. I highly recommend it to anyone who needs help with their pet, whether it's a cat, like mine, or a dog!
Attentive, polite, and very refined! An excellent professional, I recommend him to everyone! Very calm and patient, and he did a complete analysis of my cat. You can call him, it's a sure thing!
Wonderful service! Very understanding and patient, my dog ​​improved a lot with just a few sessions, I highly recommend them!
Excellent service, with great care and attention to my dog! I highly recommend them.
My experience with dog training wasn't what I expected. Unfortunately, it wasn't effective in resolving my dog ​​Fred's reactivity.
He helped us a lot with training our dogs! Excellent professional!
Very patient and calm, seems to know what he's talking about. Cat training.
Gabriel was amazing in his service! He clearly knew what he was talking about and was super creative with my cat! I highly recommend him for any occasion!!!

Initially, I gave him 5 stars because while I was paying for the lessons, he was attentive and we made progress with the interaction between our three cats. However, we felt that the interaction had stalled; we would send him messages and he would simply read them and not respond. The contract states that we have support via WhatsApp after the lessons, but that didn't happen. We ended up giving up on continuing with him and hired another professional.
